The native effect producer failed every normal contained fixture because it recorded the
extractor's read-only input-archive open without an entry owner. Gate 4 then stopped before
its first matrix run because the adapter's artifact ordering/origin violated the shared
isolation provenance contract. Two scoped target fixes allow the existing trusted WSL
host/controller broker to complete the fixed qualification without changing acceptance rules.

The completed 480-run matrix records `V2_NATIVE_EFFECT_OBSERVATION_NOT_QUALIFIED`: 420 success,
60 expected rejection, and 13/14 mandatory criteria passing. Required replacement coverage
fails because duplicate-path truncates the same inode in 20/20 full runs. Gate 5 remains
blocked. Immutable raw evidence, both failed attempts, independent controller/host reader
reports and SHA-256 identities are retained in the updated experiment summary.

Task Contract: the user's Gate 3/4 WSL environment recovery and automatic qualification request.
Starting revision: `55751696a59e8ee4e278625d24fe320973395399`.
Clean executed revision: `36ff7fdb0e31db72b3e581fd1c089b712b4a7b4e`.
The scoped task delta consists of commits `66cd9f6`, `36ff7fd` and the evidence/status commit.
This draft targets main per repository workflow and also contains the existing unmerged v2
stack; it requires review with those prerequisites, including open PR #88. Original main and
stacked branch heads were preserved.

Validation:

- Existing image verification: 2 checks passed; rebuilt target uses the existing pinned Dockerfile.
- Gate 3 contained suite on the fixed revision: 10 checks passed, including timeout/overflow.
- Related portable tests: 30 passed; the new provenance regression failed before the fix.
- Dev Container `make check`: Ruff, format, Pyright, 1,387 tests, environment and docs passed.
- Fixed Gate 4: 480 runs plus required failure injections; runner test passed while its
  qualification decision is NOT_QUALIFIED.
- Fresh controller and host processes each verified 320 native bundles and 160 stock records,
  regenerated the mechanical summary and reproduced the negative decision.
- All 1,180 retained session files passed checksum verification. Final docs/link and diff checks passed.

Qualification SHA-256: `ca2dae9150813c6df14df10e16de65b1139550a7ecd761a30122c717e4575a90`.
Session archive SHA-256: `6b0a5b31d52d00347259342683941692181e93515d7f82384df86d9fb1cab1e5`.
Raw artifacts are retained locally in the named runtime volume and the ignored WSL
`experiments/raw/node-effect-gates-20261013-AA8cvq` mirror/archive; they are not Git blobs.

Scope of the recovery delta from the starting Gate 4 revision: target worker/adapter,
regression/integration checks and evidence/status documentation.
Generic model/observer/oracle/feedback, C0-C4 contracts, extractor options, fixtures and
acceptance logic are unchanged. No native campaign, Gate 5, vulnerability or effectiveness
claim is introduced.

## Scope

Implements the N04 generic synthetic-only Task Contract for a separately versioned `namespace_rebinding_sequence`. This does not change v2 `namespace_replacement`, C0/C1/C2, old policy IDs, or historical evidence.

## Included

- schema 3 dependency/composite/finite feedback types
- strict v3 raw reader bound to an external manifest digest and a complete, valid, successful v2 trace
- same-entry/path, explicit-absence, producer-dependency, conflict-free derivation
- unchanged v2 key tuple plus tagged finite v3 keys
- 22 synthetic positive/negative/tamper/nonredundancy checks
- Task Contract, D034, routing/status and verification report

## Validation

- `make check` in isolated Linux check image as `vscode` UID/GID 1000
- Ruff check: PASS
- Ruff format: PASS (357 files)
- Pyright: PASS (0 errors)
- pytest: PASS (1,584)
- environment validation: PASS
- docs validation: PASS (128 Markdown files)

## Adversarial correction

Independent AI review of head `5acd9a0` returned REQUEST_CHANGES after reproducing a self-consistent dependency-token forgery. Head `44e115b` requires the frozen external manifest expected raw SHA-256 before parsing/derivation and adds the missing removal-only, invalid, timed-out and sequence-tamper regressions. A fresh independent review is required.

## Claim boundary

Generic implementation is IMPLEMENTED / SYNTHETIC TESTED. Native dependency producer is NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Native qualification, P0/P1/P2 effectiveness, B0/B1/B3 pilot, and historical rediscovery are NOT_RUN and not authorized by this PR. No human expert approval is claimed.

Independent adversarial re-review and both GitHub CI jobs are required before merge.

structuredContent.body:
이 PR을 병합하면 make demo-native 결과에서 step마다 실제 node-tar 중간 관찰과 피드백 선택 근거를 확인할 수 있다.

## 분류
P0-2(중간 상태 관찰 출력), P0-4(선택 근거 기록). BACKLOG 1번.

## 변경 (보고 코드만)
`src/inodefence/effect_demo.py`의 `effect_campaign_report`(synthetic·native 공용)에서 `DEMO_REPORT_SCHEMA`를 1에서 2로 올리고, step마다 아래 필드를 추가했다. 기존 필드와 그 의미는 그대로다.

- `trace`: `render_effect_trace`가 쓰는 값을 구조화한 것
  - 항목: `entries`(entry_index·path·type·link_target·effect_event_count), `effect_events`(entry_index, start/completion_sequence, operation, outcome, association, effect_class, evidence_strength, `paths[].before/after`), `observation_failures`, `sources`, `synthetic`
  - before/after는 모델의 `EffectObservationStatus`(present/absent/not_observed)를 그대로 쓴다. lstat 값(object_type, st_dev, st_ino, st_nlink, size)은 present일 때만 들어간다. event에 `EffectPathEvidence` 기록 자체가 없는 path는 `null`이다.
  - 상한: step당 event 64개. 잘리면 `effect_events_truncated: true`로 표시하고, `effect_events_total`과 entry별 `effect_event_count`에는 잘리기 전 전체 개수가 남는다.
- `selection`: mutation step의 선택 근거. seed step은 `null`이다. PR #131의 두 채널로 나눴다.
  - ① `corpus_admission`: `corpus_size_before`(parent를 뽑은 corpus 크기)와 `retained`(이 child가 이후 parent 후보에 들어가는지)
  - ② `operator_weights`: `weights_before`, `reward`, `weights_after`
  - 그 밖에 parent_case_id, selected_operator_id, selected_weight, new_effect_key_count
  - `corpus_size_before`는 기존 helper `_corpus_before_steps`로 앞 step들의 기록된 `retained` 플래그를 세어 얻는다. `EffectSearchState.consider`에서 corpus append는 `retained`일 때만 일어난다.
- `target_stderr`: `{text, chars, truncated}`. 2000자를 넘으면 앞 1000자와 뒤 1000자만 남기고 사이에 `[... N chars omitted ...]` 표시를 넣는다. `chars`는 원래 총 길이다.

`scripts/run_effect_demo.py`는 바꾸지 않았다. `native_demo_report`가 같은 함수를 부르므로 native JSON에도 같은 필드가 들어간다.

## 바꾸지 않은 것
oracle, scheduler, producer, 격리 설정, 정책 비교 결과(`compare_effect_campaign_reports`는 기존 필드만 읽는다). lifecycle event와 frontier는 이 PR 범위 밖이다.

## 검증
- Dev Container `make check` 통과(1739 passed, pyright 0 errors).
- synthetic seed 123, budget 20 CLI를 2회 실행해 바이트 동일함을 확인했다. 기존 byte-identical 테스트도 유지된다. JSON 크기는 41 KB에서 117 KB로 늘었다.
- 새 테스트(`tests/test_effect_demo.py`)가 확인하는 것:
  - trace·stderr 필드 내용
  - selection이 scheduler_evidence 및 다시 센 corpus와 일치하는지(parent가 그 corpus 안에 있는지 포함), reward와 편입이 각각 한 번 이상 나오는지
  - not_observed와 기록 없음(null)의 구분
  - synthetic이 아닌 source에서 `synthetic: false`
  - event 상한과 잘림 기록
  - stderr의 앞/뒤 보존과 생략 표시
- **native(호스트, 사람 실행·보고)**: `make demo-native` 2회 실행, demo run. 기본값은 P2·M1·seed 123·budget 20이다. 증거 파일은 `~/inodefence-evidence/inodefence-effect-demo-native-20261024-134737.json`(2회차).
  - 상단: schema 2, producer native, label demo run, node-tar 7.5.22, 20 steps
  - 20/20 step에서 `trace.synthetic`이 false다.
  - link 작업에서 extract/a.txt와 extract/b.txt 모두 `st_nlink` 2가 관찰됐다.
  - step 8·18은 effect event 0개이고 `operation_correlation_conflict`가 기록됐으며 `target_stderr`가 있다. step 8의 stderr는 `TAR_ENTRY_ERROR path contains '..'`(거부 입력)이다.
  - `selection`: reward 1이면서 retained true인 step은 5·12·19다(새 effect key 각 2개, `corpus_size_before` 4·5·6). step 5에서 add_entry 가중치가 1→2로 올랐다.
  - 두 실행의 step별 case_id·parent_case_id·selection이 동일했다(SAME_LOOP). st_ino와 timing은 비교에서 뺐다.
  - LOG에 demo run으로 기록했고, BACKLOG 1번은 `완료`로 바꿨다.

## 참고
synthetic fixture는 hardlink 뒤에도 `st_nlink`를 1로 기록한다. report는 이 fixture 값을 고치지 않고 그대로 옮긴다.
